bolivia_venezuela.scene: Shared South American rainforest travel linking Bolivia and Venezuela: close landscape view of a small forest waterfall plunging into an emerald pool, layered tropical foliage and giant tree roots on the bank, gentle humid overcast light, no famous named landmark or fabricated border.

brazil_chile.alt: Лошади у ограды на зелёных холмах Южной Америки

brazil_chile_peru.alt: Морские львы на скалах тихоокеанского побережья

brazil_chile_uruguay.scene: Shared Brazil-Uruguay gaucho countryside: a low wooden table with a traditional mate gourd and metal thermos at right beside a rustic fence, expansive golden grassland and grazing horses in the distance, warm late afternoon sun, natural still-life within a broad landscape.

brazil_paraguay.scene: Brazil-Paraguay shared Parana river landscape: powerful wide river seen from a natural rocky overlook with subtropical green forest on both banks, a small boat distant, bright sky reflected in calm areas of water, sweeping morning panorama without false named landmarks.

brazil_peru.alt: Тихая протока Амазонии с отражениями леса

brazil_uruguay.scene: Brazil-Uruguay shared Atlantic coast: long empty sandy beach with grassy dunes, a gentle curling surf line and scattered dark stones, one distant walker gives scale, overcast silver morning with a warm break in clouds, diagonal shore-level composition.

chile_peru.alt: Дорога Альтиплано у лагуны и вулканов

chile_uruguay.alt: Виноградники и бокалы вина на фоне зелёных холмов
chile_uruguay.scene: Wine travel connecting Chile and Uruguay: rustic outdoor table with two unbranded wine glasses and a small bunch of dark grapes overlooking orderly vineyard rows on gentle green hills, no high mountains, soft golden hour light, natural editorial still-life within panoramic landscape.

colombia_peru.alt: Розовый речной дельфин в водах Амазонии
colombia_peru.scene: Amazon river shared by Colombia and Peru: a pink river dolphin briefly surfacing in a calm broad forest-lined river, the dolphin small and anatomically natural in middle distance, water-level view with lush palms and hazy dawn sky, authentic wildlife travel photograph.

costa-rica_el-salvador.alt: Сёрфинговая волна у тёмного тихоокеанского пляжа

costa-rica_el-salvador_guatemala_hondura.alt: Тропа среди древовидных папоротников туманного леса

costa-rica_el-salvador_guatemala_mexico.alt: Оливковая черепаха у прибоя на рассвете

costa-rica_el-salvador_guatemala_nicarag.alt: Синее озеро среди лесистых склонов кальдеры

costa-rica_el-salvador_honduras.alt: Кофейные плантации на склонах Центральной Америки

costa-rica_el-salvador_honduras_mexico.alt: Каменная платформа майя в тропическом лесу
costa-rica_el-salvador_honduras_mexico.scene: Shared Maya heritage of Honduras and Mexico: low ancient stepped stone platform with weathered carved limestone panels amid a tropical forest clearing, massive tree roots foreground, diagonal ground-level view, bright green leaves after rain and warm filtered sun, NO arches, NO European masonry, NO round doorways, no invented giant monuments.
